title: Double Gauss f50 F1.8 / compact manual whole-unit helicoid

parts.name: 01_OpticalCartridge
parts.role: One moving optical barrel; two guide lands, integral flat stop, rear stack seat and front flange. No separate lens cells.

parts.name: 02_FrontSpacer
parts.role: Thick constant-OD spacer with broad radial rear flange and 1 mm axial end lands; barrel step relieved 0.3 mm to avoid bypassing G2.

parts.name: 03_FrontRetainer
parts.role: Nominal M46 retaining ring, 3 mm axial; preloads G1-spacer-G2 against cartridge shoulder.

parts.name: 04_RearSpacer34
parts.role: Thick spacer G3 to G4; constant OD42, broad root, 1.5 mm axial end lands. G3 alone seats on cartridge shoulder.

parts.name: 05_RearSpacer45
parts.role: Thick spacer G4 to G5; constant OD46, no independent G4/G5 axial shoulders; one rear cap preloads the stack.

parts.name: 06_RearRetainer
parts.role: Nominal rear retainer OD48; rear cap -> G5 -> spacer45 -> G4 -> spacer34 -> G3 -> cartridge shoulder. Preload requires engineering control.

parts.name: 07_IntegratedHousing
parts.role: One-piece fixed exterior and guide bore; external single-start helicoid; rear mount attachment.

parts.name: 08_ShortFocusRing
parts.role: Rotating and translating helicoid nut; 18 mm grip band; 24.7 mm total including front coupling flange.

parts.name: 09_CouplingKeeper
parts.role: Nominal M50 keeper captures focus-ring lip between two thrust washers; independent from optical retainers.

parts.name: 10_FrontThrustWasher
parts.role: Replaceable 0.26 mm low-friction coupling washer; final axial preload set by keeper.

parts.name: 11_RearThrustWasher
parts.role: Rear coupling washer rests against optical cartridge flange.

parts.name: 12_EFMountInterfaceEnvelope
parts.role: EF datum at Z=0, image plane at Z=44 mm. Purchased bayonet represented by envelope only; custom attachment pattern is not an official Canon standard.

mount.representation: Purchased mount envelope only; no validated bayonet tabs, locking notch or electrical contacts.

focus.thread: Custom single-start left-hand trapezoid, lead6/pitch6, nominal major diameter62. Not a catalog ISO Tr designation.
focus.scheme: Ring rotates and translates; captive front thrust joint moves the nonrotating optical cartridge; two flush M3 dog screws in closed straight slots prevent rotation and limit travel.

assembly_order: Build G2-spacer-G1 front stack; rear G3-spacer34-G4-spacer45-G5-one rear retainer
Fit purchased EF mount carrier to one-piece fixed housing
Insert optical cartridge from front, fit two flush guide screws before ring
Fit rear thrust washer against cartridge front flange
Wind focus ring on correct helicoid start from front, reach reference position without forcing stops
Fit front thrust washer, adjustable keeper and keeper lock screw
Check complete stroke and establish infinity by optical testing; mark distances afterwards
warnings: EF bayonet remains an unverified purchased-part envelope, not a machining drawing; custom screw pattern is ours.
Source image plane retained: paraxial BFL differs by about0.108 mm; infinity scale must be optically calibrated.
Rear mechanical envelope extends12 mm behind EF datum; body-specific mirror sweep not checked.
No diaphragm blades/electronics added; original fixed stop travels with optical group.
